answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable bond before it may place orders or cast governance votes. A contract rate-limits new bonds per funding source and makes the bond slashable when an identity is proven to double-vote or coordinate fraudulently. The willow, prism, and dawn agents may all join, but creating thousands of them ties up capital in thousands of bonds, while detected abuse destroys those funds. This raises the cost of a sybil attack; it does not make identities impossible to fake.
